name: inferindex
description: Compare LLM API prices across 150+ providers and aggregators: cheapest offer, provider comparison, price history, cost estimates, and whether self-hosting on rented GPUs beats the API.

interface.shortDescription: Compare LLM API prices across providers, and check if self-hosting on rented GPUs beats the API.
interface.longDescription: Find the cheapest provider for an LLM model, compare every provider with its usage conditions and reliability, estimate what a workload will cost per request and per month, and check how a price moved. Also estimates whether renting GPUs to run an open model beats the API, from published benchmarks and rental prices (hardware rental only). Answers come from live InferIndex data, with the API call behind each number.
defaultPrompt: Which provider is cheapest for DeepSeek V3.2 right now?
Estimate the monthly cost of 1,000 requests a day with 2,000 input and 500 output tokens on gpt-oss-120b
Is it cheaper to self-host Qwen3.8 27B than to use an API?
